title: System → distinct accomplishments
summary: Each accomplishment links a compatible set of facts, metrics and boundaries.
body:
Each accomplishment links a compatible set of facts, metrics and boundaries.

Building a workflow, improving operation and enabling adoption can be distinct achievements; renaming the same achievement does not create breadth.
